name: sl-pron
description: Native-Slovenian pronunciation (SL-Pron): EN→SL translation, IPA, SLPROS-1 prosody, and W3C Web-Speech-API directives. Includes deep L1–L6 word validation with continuous-verification loop.

tools.name: lookup_phrase
tools.summary: O(1) phrasebook hit for an English phrase.

tools.name: translate_and_speak
tools.summary: Full EN→SL→SLPROS-1 pipeline; returns a Web-Speech-API-conformant directive.

tools.name: validate_word
tools.summary: Deep L1-L6 validation of an EN↔SL pair; persists to verified_extensions.jsonl when score ≥ 0.90.

tools.name: get_phonetic
tools.summary: Return Sloleks IPA + syllables + stress index for a Slovenian word.

invariants: Every tool response ends with a `next` string (⟶ NEXT convention).
Outputs are locked to lang=sl-SI; never_fall_back_to_other_language=true.
IPA is always shown alongside orthography for agent + human consumers.
validate_word writes only records it could itself reproduce via the shipped pipeline.
